reviews.title: The worst company ever!
reviews.body: The worst company ever!! I called them in September 2025 and asked them for a sim for simply one month ONLY just to use data for a relative visiting England. The agent told me I will only be charged for September and assured me of this. I triple checked before hanging up the phone and the agent reassured me every time. I’ve checked my account in June 2026 and saw they’ve charged me from September 2025 till July 2026. I called and explained the situation even though I was reassured I wouldn’t be charged. I called them in July 2026 and they asked for evidence which I sent and the refund was initiated. I was told to wait 5-7 working days to receive it. It is now almost October 2026 and I still haven’t recieved the refund. The reason for this is because everytime I waited 5-7 working days, I would call them to chase my refund and they would say wait another 5-7 days. They have done this from July all the way till now, 27th September 2025, a whole YEAR from when this happened!!! I’ve made multiple complaints and asked for compensation. I was promised both a FULL refund and compensation on top, but still nothing. This company is a joke and they are stealing peoples money. I will not stop until I get my refund. I am expecting £100 refund that I will get whether I need to take them to court or not! Do not use Lebara, the colleagues are useless and it is not worth the headache.

reviews.title: If I could score zero
reviews.body:
If I could score zero , or minus I would 

Do not be fooled by too good to be true promotional deals 

I haven’t been able to use most services since getting my sim , and all of a sudden can’t use anything at all now , I got this for my daughter for starting seniors , she has additional needs, and not having access to data and phone calls is putting her in a very possible unsafe situations

I’ve been paying for a service which for the most part has not been provided, plus have effectively lost out on the benefit of the promotional period (which makes me question is this their intention?)

I reported the issue 2 weeks ago and still nothing , they provide timescales and don’t adhere to them at all 

The staff you get to speak to are shockingly bad, they speak to you very rudely and patronising, they also literally hang up the minute they realise it’s not a straightforward call  , they will also say a manager will call back , and it never happens 

I have worked in customer service for 20 plus years and never known such terrible service on this level 

I have even been left to research what the problem may be, and informed them 
And it’s very possible that all they need to do is send me a replacement sim , as the one they have provided is likely corrupt , or a factory misprint 

Yet how has the company not even attempted this 2 weeks in, and also said they can’t try to initiate trying this simple possible fix, now that a complaint has been logged, never ever heard anything like it 

It’s been so shockingly bad, with no resolution to date, that I will be reporting this to the communications ombudsman 

I’d avoid them at all costs

reviews.title: Stephen Shurrock and John-Paul Patten: eight days without service despite escalation
reviews.body:
Eight days without outgoing calls, texts or mobile data. A paid monthly plan I cannot use. A promised same-day callback that never happened. This is my experience of Lebara’s complaint handling.

I have escalated this matter to Stephen Shurrock and John-Paul Patten, yet my service remains barred and my central questions remain unanswered. In my view, this reflects disgracefully on the company’s leadership and its treatment of customers when something goes wrong.

I reported unauthorised payments and repeated attempts to transfer my number to another SIM. After I disputed the payments through my bank, Lebara barred my service and told me to reverse the chargeback or pay £15 before restoration would be considered.

Since then, I have spent hours chasing answers. The written responses read like automated templates: the matter has been “escalated”, someone will investigate, someone will contact me. But when a representative specifically promised to call back that same day, nobody did.

The consequences go far beyond inconvenience. I am struggling to manage medical appointments, coordinate care for ill family members and access maps when travelling to work sites. When my disabled mother recently fell, I was unable to contact her carers using my barred service. I have told Lebara about this impact.

I still do not know what investigation has been completed, whether my account was compromised or what measures have been taken to secure it. Despite repeated requests, I also have no deadlock letter, although Lebara previously described its position as final.

Lebara has highlighted its own financial loss. Meanwhile, I am left paying for an unusable plan and dealing with the disruption to my work and family responsibilities.

Stephen Shurrock and John-Paul Patten: please ensure someone takes ownership of this complaint. Another public invitation to email you is inadequate when I have already done so repeatedly.

I want an urgent review to restore my service, a named person responsible for resolving the complaint, clear written answers about account security and reimbursement for the paid service I have been unable to use. If Lebara maintains its final position, provide the requested deadlock letter.

I will update this review to reflect any meaningful action, however I will continue to review you until you take meaningful action. At present, my experience is of broken promises, unanswered questions and unacceptable customer service.
